sql:
SELECT p.ProductName, sum(i.OnHandQuantity) AS OnHand, sum(i.SafetyStockQuantity) AS SafetyStock, sum(i.OnHandQuantity) - sum(i.SafetyStockQuantity) AS Gap
FROM retail.FactInventory AS i
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON p.ProductKey = i.ProductKey
INNER JOIN (SELECT ProductKey, max(DateKey) AS MaxDate FROM retail.FactInventory GROUP BY ProductKey) AS l ON l.ProductKey = i.ProductKey AND l.MaxDate = i.DateKey
GROUP BY p.ProductName
ORDER BY Gap DESC
LIMIT 10
